newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Banks see zloty at 2.8768 vs dlr end-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Banks see zloty at 2.8768 vs dlr end-96.

text.p: The Polish zloty is seen easing against the dollar by year-end, with the prediction more pessimistic than last month, according to a Reuter poll of the country's 25 largest banks.
By the end of 1996, the zloty is expected to fall to 2.8768 to the dollar versus Thursday's fixing of 2.8095, the poll showed.
The 2.8768 rate is a mean average of forecasts that ranged between 2.8350 and 2.9210.
Last month, banks had predicted a fall in the Polish unit to 2.8527 by year-end. Forecasts ranged from 2.6900 to 2.8950.
The zloty is expected to trade at an average of 2.8302 in October, with a range of forecasts between 2.8000 and 2.8750.
Banks estimated the zloty would fall to an average of 3.0902 to the dollar in October 1997 with a range of forecasts from 2.9400 to 3.3000.
